thread:
nina: Heads-up: nightly vitest run started failing after we made SDK ESM-only. Error in CI (node18) is `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')` during vi.mock of the client. Local node20 is fine.

omar: that's the usual ESM/CJS interop dance. Are your tests mocking default export or named?

fnx: default. test: `vi.mock('redwood-inference', () => ({ Client: MockClient }))` but package's dist exports default.

omar: try switching mocks to ESM style: `vi.mock('redwood-inference', async () => { const real = await vi.importActual('redwood-inference'); return { default: { ...real.default, query: () => 'x' } } })`

nina: tried that, improved but then got `ReferenceError: exports is not defined` from a transitive dep compiled to CJS.

fnx: add deps.inline for that dep in vitest.config and set esbuild platform node:
```ts
export default defineConfig({
 test: {
  environment: 'node',
  deps: { inline: [/some-cjs-dep/] },
  esbuild: { platform: 'node', target: 'node18' }
 }
})
```
That fixed the exports error for us previously.

omar: if you still need compatibility for CI (node18), consider a test-only shim that re-exports a CJS-shaped module. Example: `test/helpers/esm-to-cjs-shim.mjs` that imports dist/index.mjs and `export default` plus named exports so `require` consumers can mock it.

nina: can you paste a tiny shim?

omar: sure:
```mjs
// test/helpers/esm-to-cjs-shim.mjs
import pkg from '../../dist/index.mjs';
const _default = pkg.default ?? pkg;
export default _default;
export const Client = _default.Client;
```
Then in tests import the shim path and mock that.

felix: for jest specifically, also set `extensionsToTreatAsEsm` and ensure `transformIgnorePatterns` doesn't ignore the ESM deps. Jest wants cjs by default, so either transform or provide a cjs test bundle.

ci-bot: nightly 1765009999-vitest: failed 4/4 on node18. Logs: /artifacts/1765009999-vitest.log

nina: typings issue too: `Property 'createClient' does not exist on type 'typeof import("../dist")'`. Our typedefs are old `export =` style.

omar: update index.d.ts to export both default and named: `declare class RedwoodClient {}; declare const _default: RedwoodClient; export default _default; export { RedwoodClient };`

felix: short-term we used a `build:test:cjs` script that produces a CJS bundle under dist-test/ used only by CI/tests. Longer term publish dual entrypoints with exports map.

nina: thanks. I'll open a small DX doc with: vitest config snippet, shim example, d.ts pattern, and CI suggestions (add node20 to matrix or build-test:cjs). Will attach failing log to PR.

omar: one more: recommend test authors prefer `vi.stubModule`/`vi.importActual` for ESM mocking to avoid shape mismatch.

nina: will include examples. ping me if you want to pair on the shim. :raised_hands:
